mechanism: Domain data pipeline and three-stage post-training (CPT, SFT, RL) of molecular-dynamics code models
evidence_scope: we adopt a three stage post-training strategy—continued pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and rein- forcement learning (RL)—to train two domain-adapted models, MD-Instruct and MD-Code.
evidence_role: we present MDAgent2, the first end-to-end framework capa- ble of performing both knowledge Q&A and code generation within the MD domain.
